title: with no launch in the log (no registry, or one with no valid line) tree prints one line and exits 0
source: intended: defect N-30; the rollups come from cli/jitso/tree.ts buildTree and tree.test.ts
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-30). `jitso tree [<launch_id>]` prints the launch tree, one line per launch in preorder, indented two spaces per depth: `<id> <build> <state>: verdict <verdict>, US$ <cost> list, <tokens> tokens, peak <peak>, budget <pct>%, <k> rule break(s), <a> of <n> analyzed`, with the rollups of the launch's branch (cost and tokens summed, peak context and budget percentage the maximum, rule breaks counted, the worst verdict of the analyzed launches or `pending`). With nothing to print it prints `jitso tree: no launches` and exits 0, whether the registry is missing or holds only lines that are not valid events.
